DOCMATE AI / SYNTHETIC TEST DATA 02
SYNTHETIC RECORDS / FX-101 TO FX-103
Febrile illness
Compare time course, explicit negatives and an incomplete intake. FX-101 | Cedar-17 | Dengue evidence review
Record. Adult, 32. Fever entered on day 1. On day 4, lower temperature was recorded alongside
persistent vomiting and abdominal pain. Symptom entries are self-reported. No test result is attached. Evidence statement. Cedar-17 records persistent vomiting on day 4 after the fever was reported lower. Record limitation. Examination, fluid intake and test result are unrecorded. The intake tag does not
establish a diagnosis. FX-102 | Maple-24 | Fever and cough with negatives
Record. Adult, 41. Cough for five days. At the time of the recorded call the patient denied fever and
shortness of breath. No in-person examination was documented. Evidence statement. Maple-24 documents cough for five days and explicitly records no fever at the time
of the call. Record limitation. Past fever history, observations and examination findings are unavailable. FX-103 | Birch-09 | Fever intake with missing observations
Record. Adult, 27. The entire intake is “feels hot since yesterday.” No measured temperature, symptom
review or examination appears in the record. Evidence statement. Birch-09 contains a reported fever without a measured temperature or documented
examination. Record limitation. Measured vital signs, associated symptoms and examination are missing.

DOCMATE AI / SYNTHETIC TEST DATA 04
SYNTHETIC RECORDS / FX-107 TO FX-109
Blood pressure and metabolic
documentation
Preserve units, dates and the difference between a reading and a diagnosis. FX-107 | Orchid-42 | Two blood pressure readings
Record. Adult, 61. A clinic intake lists an upper-arm measurement of 148/94 mmHg and a later entry on a
separate day of 142/90 mmHg. Both are recorded observations. Evidence statement. Orchid-42 lists 148/94 mmHg on the first visit and 142/90 mmHg on the second
visit. Record limitation. Measurement conditions and clinician assessment are unrecorded. FX-108 | Iris-08 | Blood pressure measurement disagreement
Record. Adult, 46. The home diary shows 131/82 mmHg at 07:30. The clinic intake shows 151/92 mmHg
at 14:20. Device validation is unknown. Evidence statement. Iris-08 labels 131/82 mmHg as home and 151/92 mmHg as clinic. Record limitation. Measurement technique, repeat readings and device validation are missing. FX-109 | Lotus-27 | Glucose with unknown fasting status
Record. Adult, 52. Glucose 168 mg/dL was transcribed from a point-of-care screen. The meal timing field
is empty. No interpretation was entered. Evidence statement. Lotus-27 records glucose of 168 mg/dL with fasting status unknown. Record limitation. Confirm specimen, timing, device and clinician interpretation.
